bindTooltip: The network card the emulated Rokus bind to and advertise on. Leave it on 'all interfaces' — the routable IP is detected automatically, so it works out of the box. Only pick a specific address on a host with several network cards.
devicesHelp: Each card is one emulated Roku. Add one, then add a Roku device in your Harmony or Sofabaton app pointing at this ioBroker host — every keypress lands in the device's objects.
devicePortHint: The ECP port this Roku answers on. Each emulated Roku needs its own port. Harmony and Sofabaton read the port from the discovery.
deviceTypeHint: "Player" exposes the 16 standard remote keys. "TV" additionally exposes volume, power, channel and input keys.
deviceNameInUse: This name is already used by another device.
devicePortInUse: This port is already used by another Roku.
deviceNameInvalid: This name can't be used — it is reserved or maps to the same object id as another device.
deviceNameRejected: This name can't be used: it is already taken, reserved for the adapter, or maps to the same object id as another device.
aboutInfo: If this adapter is useful to you, a small donation helps keep it maintained — thank you!
connectionStatusDesc: True only while everything runs: every configured emulated Roku listens, discovery answers and the chosen address exists.
stateLastCommandDesc: The most recent command this emulated Roku received, as plain text.
channelKeysDesc: One state per remote key this device offers; a key press pulses it briefly.
channelDeviceInfoDesc: Whether this emulated Roku runs and, if not, why.
stateOnlineDesc: True while this emulated Roku listens on its ECP port.
stateErrorDesc: Why this emulated Roku does not run; empty while it runs, Unknown while the adapter is off or starting.
devicesTotalDesc: How many emulated Rokus are configured.
devicesOnlineDesc: How many emulated Rokus listen right now.
devicesAllOnlineDesc: True while every configured emulated Roku listens; false while none is configured.
